title: What will happen if we execute the following query?

blocks.content: What will happen if we execute the following query?
The query will not execute because you cannot refer to the calculated average in the WHERE clause directly.
To correct the query, you can use a subquery:

1SELECT AVG(salary)
2FROM Employees
3WHERE department = 'Development' AND salary < (
4  SELECT AVG(salary)
5  FROM Employees
6);
